'''The Ugly Stick''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] dropped by [[Tembarr Treefall]], a boss who can be found in [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Bludgeoner]] from crafters [[Mathilde]] or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Vampiric]] [[Hammer Haft]]
*Perfect [[Hammer Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]


Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
